todaysEvents.delta: ICE Endex Nov26 delayed Last: 95.155 EUR/MWh at Oct 26 20:45 GMT, not settlement. Trading Economics JKM-linked CFD: $32.20/MMBtu (+2.47%) on Oct 26; Reuters' $22 Platts-linked assessment from Jul 24 remains carried.

The latest audited source remains Reuters, Oct 23: the Washington Institute map recorded 28 reported and confirmed October attacks and 113 since Feb 28. UKMTO says voluntary reporting leaves gaps; the review found no newer Oct 26/27 article.

scenarios.label: Base
scenarios.description: Mediation produces agreed sequencing and monitored reopening. Reuters' Oct 23 attack tally does not verify a reopening agreement or durable shipping normalisation.

scenarios.label: Stress
scenarios.summary: Selective passage continues amid shipping disruptions.
scenarios.description: Selective passage and export rerouting coexist with reported incidents. Reuters cites a Washington Institute map recording 28 confirmed and reported attacks in Hormuz-area waters during October; UKMTO says voluntary reporting misses some incidents.

scenarios.label: Tail
scenarios.summary: Talks stall or attacks disrupt more export routes.
scenarios.description: Sequencing disagreements persist or attacks further disrupt Hormuz and alternative export routes. War-risk insurance, route-normalised freight and replacement LNG costs remain unverified.
